I. \(\quad \Gamma\) passes through \((1,2)\).
II. \(\quad \Gamma\) is the angle bisectors of the angles formed between \(L_{1}\) and \(L_{2}\).
III. \(\quad \Gamma\) is a pair of straight lines, one line is parallel to the \(x\)-axis and the other is parallel to the \(y\)-axis.
questions.stemZh:
26. 動點 \(P\) 到 \(L_1:x-2y+3=0\)、\(L_2:x+2y-5=0\) 的距離相等。以 \(\Gamma\) 表示軌跡。下列哪些敘述必定正確？
I. \(\Gamma\) 經過 \((1,2)\)。
II. \(\Gamma\) 是兩直線所成角的角平分線。
III. \(\Gamma\) 是兩條直線，其中一條平行於 \(x\) 軸，另一條平行於 \(y\) 軸。
questions.solution:

Answer: D
Equal denominators give \(|x-2y+3|=|x+2y-5|\). The two branches are \(y=2\) and \(x=1\). They meet at \((1,2)\) and are horizontal and vertical. They are the angle bisectors, so all three statements hold.

答案: D
兩距離分母相等，故 \(|x-2y+3|=|x+2y-5|\)。分支為 \(y=2\)、\(x=1\)；兩條均經過 \((1,2)\)，且分別水平、垂直。它們正是兩直線的角平分線，三項均正確。

Q71. mock-cpu-2324-p2-final-q26
Answer: B
The distance denominators are both \(\sqrt5\), giving \(|2x+y-5|=|x-2y+5|\). The branches are \(x+3y-10=0\) and \(3x-y=0\), with slopes \(-\frac13\) and \(3\), so III is true. \((1,3)\) lies on both branches, so I is true. Substituting \((1,0)\) gives left sides \(-9\) and \(3\), so II is false.
